title: Olive and the Blue Feather
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'ue' and 'aw'.

pages.brief: Grey clouds gathering over the garden hedge.
Olive the owl looking around the hedge for small treasures to collect.
Olive the owl noticing one bright blue feather caught in the hedge.
Close view of the bright blue feather against the green hedge leaves.
Olive the owl carefully lifting the blue feather with one claw.
Olive the owl turning the blue feather over, studying it closely.
Olive the owl glancing up towards Pip's nest in a nearby tree.
Olive the owl flying across the garden with the blue feather.
Pip the sparrow smiling as Olive holds out his lost blue feather.
Olive the owl and Pip the sparrow sitting together in the hedge.
